title: Metering Service Decision Memo: Correction Target in Referee Backbill Settlements
content:
**Decision.** A **Metering Service** referee backbill settlement corrects the repriced bills to a target registration that depends on the test requests recorded on the meter installation:

- where the meter carries a utility-initiated test request, the referee backbill settlement corrects the repriced bills only to the lower edge of the tolerance band, 100 minus the meter type's accuracy tolerance, and the referee error factor is the absolute value of one minus that edge divided by the referee test's registration percentage;
- where the meter carries a periodic test request and no utility-initiated test request, the referee backbill settlement corrects the repriced bills to 100 minus one half of the meter type's accuracy tolerance, the referee error factor being the absolute value of one minus that figure divided by the referee test's registration percentage;
- where the meter carries neither, no reduced correction target applies.

**Basis.** A request is carried by the meter when it stands on the installation's test record with that reason, whatever its date. A utility-initiated request decides the target even if a periodic request is also on record.

## Targets in figures

| Meter type | Tolerance | Utility-initiated request on record | Periodic request only |
|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Communicating Opt-Out Meter | 2.0 | 98.00 | 99.00 |
| Standard AMI Smart Meter | 2.0 | 98.00 | 99.00 |
| AMI Bidirectional Net Meter | 2.0 | 98.00 | 99.00 |
| AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter | 2.0 | 98.00 | 99.00 |
| AMI Interval Demand Meter | 1.0 | 99.00 | 99.50 |
| Primary Metering Installation | 0.5 | 99.50 | 99.75 |

## Hypothetical figures

An AMI Interval Demand Meter whose referee test registered 97.00, with a utility-initiated request on record: the error factor is the absolute value of one minus 99 divided by 97, that is 0.0206186. With only a periodic request on record it is the absolute value of one minus 99.5 divided by 97, that is 0.0257732.
